result.rationale: The migration does raw SQL `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`, bypassing the model's `before_validation` normalization (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')`). Meanwhile, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` matches with `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` against the referer's URI host, so a legacy value like 'http://eviltrout.com' inserted verbatim will never match, whereas the old `allows_embeddable_host?` stripped the scheme before comparing.
